message:
Ever had one of those moments when the power goes out and you realize you’re not quite as ready as you thought? 😅 I’ve been there — scrambling around in the dark looking for candles and wondering where the flashlight went! 

I recently stumbled upon a resource that gives some great tips on how to prepare for power outages. It’s all about the little things we can do ahead of time to make those unexpected moments a bit easier. 

So, what’s your go-to trick for staying calm during a blackout? Let’s share our best tips!
